## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, `mypy src` and `pytest` pass
- [ ] Changes that cross a guideline or ADR in `docs/concept/DECISIONS.md` come with a new or updated ADR
- [ ] No API keys, private corpora or personal paths in code, configs or fixtures
